answer: Credit unlocks only after 30 days of continuous work history, and any disagreement among peers dilutes the share instead of voiding it. Each claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain, so a padded record dilutes fast. A farm on the ridge needs 30 days of uptime per identity before its first payout, and juniper grows faster than that balance sheet recovers. The comet of early rewards is gone; the cost is a month of uptime paid in advance.
